provenance.revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: sparse near-plane foreground framing prop for a side-view 2D exploration platformer
Primary request: Create exactly one isolated, connected ceiling-attached cluster of torn funerary cloth and loose dark cords. The finished artwork must be one PNG with a genuinely transparent background.
Canvas/composition: Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio, conceptually two tiles wide by three tiles tall. Center the complete prop on the canvas without cropping. Attach a narrow, ragged horizontal cloth header along the very top anchor. From that one connected header, hang two or three clearly separated tapered shroud strips, positioned off-center and leaving a broad open center. At least half of the entire canvas must remain fully transparent. The player collision envelope is conceptually one tile wide by two tiles tall; the longest strip may descend about one and one-quarter player heights but must stay off-center so the prop frames the player path instead of hiding it. Make the arrangement sparse and intentionally asymmetric, never an arch.
Subject/silhouette: unmistakably soft hanging fabric with torn, irregular hems, subtle folds, and a few loose dark cords integrated into the same connected ceiling cluster. The silhouette must read as limp cloth, never a spike, claw, bone, solid wall, platform, or collision surface. Decorative only; no collider implied.
Style/medium: production-quality 16-bit pixel art; crisp hard-edged pixels, stepped contours, deliberate pixel clusters, restrained detail density. No antialiasing, smoothing, blur, painterly texture, or photorealism.
Color palette: predominantly near-black navy and deep indigo foreground values, with muted blue-purple fold clusters and extremely restrained cool edge highlights. It should read closer than the gameplay plane without becoming a focal object.
Scene/backdrop: none. Preserve genuine alpha transparency everywhere outside the prop. No depicted environment.
Constraints: exactly one connected prop; complete subject visible; only the top header, its hanging shroud strips, and integrated loose cords; broad transparent center; at least 50 percent transparent negative space; asymmetrical; decorative fabric.
Avoid: symmetric arch, solid curtain, opaque center, pointed hazard silhouette, spikes, claws, ribs, antlers, bones, weapon, character, creature, extra objects, floor or ground plane, platform, cast shadow, scenery, text, symbols, UI, border, frame, watermark, background color, photorealism, painterly blur, smoothing, antialiasing.
